source_findings.issue: Squared Euclidean norms can overflow or underflow despite finite components. For risk [1e200,0], sqrt(dot(row,row)) becomes infinite and division makes the normalized constraint zero; tiny nonzero risk rows can be skipped. Related dose and NaN-slope paths also lacked finite checks.
source_findings.minimal_fix: Stable hypot norms for risk/own/projected vectors, finite checks of dot/solve/projection/dose/native displacement intermediates, and a finite strictly negative descent slope before copying a nonzero trial.
source_findings.title: Finite nonzero risk gradients must not disappear during cone normalization
source_findings.verification: Source review plus source-bound author fixture for the same analytical cone at over/underflow scales; no auditor floating sweep.

source_findings.issue: The initial prior document could read as subtracting an already-negative probe responsibility.
source_findings.minimal_fix: State nonnegative factual responsibility-weighted CE/BCE gradient minus nonnegative probe responsibility-weighted CE/BCE gradient.
source_findings.title: Avoid double-negative wording for the probe gradient

late_documentation_clarification: If integration doc differs, the final paragraph only clarifies that buffer/cache/RNG restoration must preserve the current private trial candidate rather than overwrite it with reference parameters. Source/score/update policy is unchanged.
